subject: literacy
concept: Understanding that a different, reasonable person might see things differently (an opposing view)
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student states their own opinion, then tries stating the opposite opinion someone else might genuinely hold
exercise.pictorial: Student matches two opposing claims to their respective supporting reasons
exercise.abstract: Student writes one sentence acknowledging what someone who disagreed might say

misconception_flags: writes a strawman version of the opposing view rather than a genuine one

interest_binding: topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
